Le Tour de Ham

Birmingham, AL · Lakeview · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Le Tour de Ham is a social group ride in Birmingham, AL. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:15 pm from Varies; current start posted in the Facebook group. About 10–12 miles, slowest rider sets the pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slowest rider sets the pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Le Tour de Ham group ride

Birmingham's slow Tuesday ride. Ten to twelve miles, no rider left behind, any bike. The same crew runs a Saturday morning stroll from Uptown. Start point and details were last confirmed in a 2018 write-up; check the Facebook page before you go.
